question: Does OpenClaw need a Discord-only warning-suppression scope in addition to the existing global `messages.suppressToolErrors` policy?
rationale: The existing setting already produces the requested warning suppression, while introducing another public config scope creates a lasting precedence and support contract that implementation review cannot decide.

options.title: Use Existing Policy
options.body: Keep the global setting canonical and improve Discord-facing documentation rather than adding a parallel config key.

options.title: Sponsor Discord Override
options.body: Retain the channel key only after defining a concrete multi-channel use case, precedence, account inheritance, documentation, and live proof.

options.title: Close The Draft
options.body: Close the PR if the existing global setting fully satisfies the reported Discord-heavy deployment.

recommendation.title: Use Existing Policy
recommendation.body: Keep the global setting canonical and improve Discord-facing documentation rather than adding a parallel config key.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced the existing suppression policy and made the recent related Discord warning-visibility decision.
